title: PR #8: fix(ci): recover Node release gates and synchronize remaining dependencies
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Fixes concrete failures from Actions run 35337255468: Node projects with stale lockfiles now regenerate dependencies after a strict npm ci failure; the A-TownChain OS docs TypeScript dependency is aligned to 6.0.3; the ATC Explorer lockfile is synchronized to TypeScript 6.0.3. The workflow still uses npm ci first and only falls back when the lockfile is stale/incompatible.
